health_checks.name: Cryptographic SHA-256 Chain Integrity
health_checks.plain: Every published prediction batch carries a SHA-256 fingerprint, and each fingerprint also hashes the one before it. That means nobody can quietly edit an old entry: the moment a single character changes, the whole chain stops recomputing.

health_checks.name: Out-of-Sample Zero-Lookahead Guard
health_checks.observed: every epoch scored on data frozen at its own cutoff
health_checks.threshold: no post-cutoff information in any feature
health_checks.plain: Each vintage is scored only on information that existed on the day it was taken, then graded against what actually happened later. It is the only way to know a score is real rather than hindsight.

health_checks.name: Manager Breakout Lift > 2.0x
health_checks.plain: If you back the top tenth of managers our score ranks, you hit real breakout companies more than twice as often as picking at random from the same universe. Industry rankings manage roughly 1.4x to 1.9x.

health_checks.name: Startup Breakout Lift (ARCHE™) > 4.5x
health_checks.plain: Among startups scored before they exited, the top tenth produced large exits about 4.7 times more often than chance. The published industry benchmark for the same task is 1.66x.

health_checks.name: Pension IRR Alpha Verified (+11.28%)
health_checks.threshold: > 0 percentage points on official LP disclosures
health_checks.plain: On the official public pension disclosures, partnerships sitting in the top half of our ranking earned 18.72% net IRR against 7.45% for the rest. The alpha is measured on money the pension actually reported, not on a back-test.

health_checks.name: Monotonic Decile Calibration (D10 vs D1 = 27.1x)
health_checks.threshold: each decile must beat the one below it
health_checks.plain: Rank the book into ten buckets and the chance of a breakout has to rise cleanly from bucket to bucket. Ours does: 1.77% in the worst bucket, 32.78% in the best. That is a 27.06x gap you can read straight off the table.

health_checks.name: Automated Cloud Heartbeat Active
health_checks.observed: daily scheduled pulse committed to the public repository
health_checks.plain: A scheduled job re-verifies the whole ledger every day and commits the result back to this repository. If the numbers ever stopped adding up, the green light would go red on its own without anyone pressing a button.
